title: Automated Segmentation of Thyroid Nodule, Gland, and Cystic Components From Ultrasound Images Using Deep Learning.
summary: The multi-output CNN segmented thyroid nodules, gland, and cystic components in prospective ultrasound data from 234 patients; its 48-patient test set had mean Dice 0.76.
